introduction: Our lab focuses on advancing artificial intelligence through machine learning, deep learning, and knowledge-driven reasoning. Our research spans multimodal AI for precision medicine, graph representation learning for biomedical discovery, large language models for drug discovery, and intelligent optimization for manufacturing.

By integrating heterogeneous data, developing innovative AI models, and exploring complex relationships, we aim to address real-world challenges and contribute to advances in healthcare, biotechnology, and industrial applications.
